name: exyu-translation-100
notes: All source lines are original test sentences written for this project (no quotes from existing films or series).
References are DRAFTS (AI-assisted) and must be reviewed by native speakers. They are one valid translation, not the only one.
Serbian references are ekavian; Croatian, Bosnian and ExYu Neutral references are ijekavian.
Do not edit this file after a benchmark run; create a new version instead.

categories.everyday: Everyday phrasing; regional vocabulary and verb forms differ between variants.
categories.humor: Joke must stay funny and short; wordplay may need adaptation.
categories.sarcasm: Ironic meaning must survive; literal translation loses the tone.
categories.emotional: Emotional register and naturalness; avoid stiff literal phrasing.
categories.action: Very short imperative lines; must stay short and natural.
categories.slang: Slang/colloquial English with no literal equivalent.
categories.idiom: Idiom must be rendered by meaning, not word by word.
categories.ambiguity: Multiple readings; context decides (references choose the most likely one).
categories.long: Long, complex sentence; subtitle length and clause structure.
categories.film-dialogue: Natural film dialogue: multiple speakers, interruptions, phrasal verbs, negation.
